hints.title: Pairs mirror each other
hints.body: A palindrome uses letters in matching pairs around its center.

hints.title: Count pairs
hints.body: For each letter, `count // 2` pairs can be used.

hints.title: One center
hints.body: If any letter count is odd, one leftover letter can sit in the middle.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
counts = frequency of each letter
pairs = sum(count // 2 for count in counts)
length = pairs * 2
if any count is odd and length < total letters:
    length += 1
return length
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
